House of Rose LLC

# Privacy Policy

House of Rose LLC respects your privacy. This policy explains
how we handle customer information, including information
connected to SMS messaging.

## Information We Collect

We may collect information you provide when you contact us,
request services, book an appointment, subscribe to messaging,
or communicate with House of Rose LLC. This may include your
name, contact information, appointment details, preferences, and
messages you send to us.

## How We Use Information

We use customer information to answer questions, provide
support, manage appointments, communicate about services, send
requested messages, and operate our business.

## Data Sharing

- • Customer data is not shared with 3rd parties for
promotional or marketing purposes.

- • Mobile opt-in and consent are never shared with anyone for
any purpose. Any information sharing that may be mentioned
elsewhere in this policy excludes mobile opt-in data.


## House of Rose LLC Messaging Terms and Conditions

1. 1\. The messaging program consists of general conversational
    messaging to answer questions and provide support to
    customers, promotional offers or discounts, any promotion of
    your products/services.

2. 2\. You can cancel the SMS service at any time. Just text 'STOP'
    to the phone number from which you received messages. After
    you send the SMS message 'STOP' to us, we will send you an
    SMS message to confirm that you have been unsubscribed.
    After this, you will no longer receive SMS messages from us.
    If you want to join again, just sign up as you did the first
    time and we will start sending SMS messages to you again.

3. 3\. If you are experiencing issues with the messaging program
    you can reply with the keyword HELP for more assistance, or
    you can get help directly at info@houseofrosefl.com.

4. 4\. Carriers are not liable for delayed or undelivered messages.

5. 5\. As always, message and data rates may apply for any messages
    sent to you from us and to us from you. Message frequency
    will vary based on communication needs. If you have any
    questions about your text plan or data plan, it is best to
    contact your wireless provider.

6. 6\. If you have any questions regarding privacy, please read our
    privacy policy contained in the rest of this document/page.


## Contact

If you have questions about this privacy policy or House of Rose
LLC messaging, use the privacy support form below. Messages are
sent from **support@updates.houseofrosefl.com**.

Privacy Support

## Send a Privacy Request

This form is handled through Resend and forwards privacy
messages to House of Rose at info@houseofrosefl.com.
